description:
`Rpc.event_to_json/1` currently loses data:

- `AgentEnd` collapses messages to `message_count: length(msgs)` —
  a client can't see the transcript.
- `MessageUpdate` emits empty `data` — can't reconstruct stream.
- `ToolExecutionEnd` collapses result content to `is_error` only.

Decide the target contract, then implement:

Option A: full structural JSON with a `Jason.Encoder` protocol
  impl on each relevant struct. Event consumers see the raw
  message/result shape.

Option B: a minimal "useful" contract — for MessageUpdate include
  the current delta text; for AgentEnd include the assistant
  stop_reason + text; for ToolExecutionEnd include the text
  content and details.

Prefer Option B — matches what upstream `pi` RPC clients need
(progress rendering + final answer) without the full struct
overhead.

TDD:
- For each event type: assert the JSON contains the fields a
  progress UI would need.
- Round-trip: encode event → decode JSON → assertions on shape.
title: RPC event serialization: richer, round-trip-capable payloads
